name: Jasmine's Hotwife Challenges
source:
In Jasmine: Hotwife For Life, you helped your wife to become a sexy, fun-loving Hotwife. Now, in part 2 of the story, you give Jasmine a list of Hotwife Challenges for her to perform, and to report back to you with stories and photos for your enjoyment.

[From [url=https://lifestyle-stories.itch.io/jasmine-hotwife-challenges]Itch.io[/url]]
